correctness.rationale: Wang classification for acyclic graph inverse semigroups reduces to hereditary H and arbitrary eligible W (one outgoing edge outside H); no cycle data. Root in H forces all H; root outside H and not in W gives product child F_i; root in W requires exactly one child root not in H, giving v sum_i(F_i-u^ni)prod_(j!=i)u^nj. For full b-ary height h evaluate (u,v)=(1,1) and v=0 to obtain C_(h+1)=1+C_h^b+b(C_h-1), R_(h+1)=1+R_h^b. Log iteration gives convergent entropy constants and o(1) error; root-level extra b choices yield strict positive kappa_b via explicit bound. Independent direct enumeration of hereditary H and W on full binary trees h<=2 and ternary h<=2 gives (7,5),(62,26) and (12,9),(1762,730), agreeing with recurrence.
